pattern: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.
criterion: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.

lesson.title: Verify Customer History Before Claiming Prior Interactions
lesson.when: A customer vaguely refers to a previously inquired product or past conversation without verified context in the evidence
lesson.do: Ask the customer to clarify the specific product or topic they inquired about, or state that past interaction details are not available
lesson.otherwise: Do not assume or state specific past products, previous conversation details, or health concerns not confirmed by source evidence
triggers: gọi lại về sản phẩm cũ
